ci_attestation_subject: ADP V0.2 P09 / T043 coverage-and-gaps production deploy + V0.2 evidence-bundle guard
summary: ADP V0.2 P09 deploys task T043 (Source-Year-Month gap detector) onto the live /system page, turning comprehensiveness from a source COUNT into visible time coverage: 37 registered sources x 127 months = 4699 cells, 69 covered, time coverage 1.5 percent, and it NAMES the six sources that have never ingested a single item (cell, cell-neuron, lancet, science-advances, stats-gov, gnews-us-tech). stats-gov is an A0 official source wired in by P04 that has never fetched anything -- a real operational finding the earlier design would have hidden forever. The v0_1 gap_detector was NOT ported as-is: against real live data it reports unexplained=0 and PASSES T043's acceptance, but only by labelling 3665 of 3937 cells source_not_yet_active, false for arXiv (1991), Nature (1869), NEJM (1812), PNAS (1915) and bioRxiv (2013) -- 1003 false cells for those eight sources alone. That acceptance cannot distinguish an honest hole from a wrong explanation, and a wrong explanation is worse, so the reason was dropped for the provable fact not_backfilled. Independent review BLOCKed with four defects, all correct, all fixed -- the worst being that the source list was derived from cn_items so zero-item sources vanished (762 cells with neither count nor reason): the SAME fallacy as v0_1, moved from the time axis to the source axis, committed inside the very patch written to eliminate it. Also adds a guard that every V0.2 evidence bundle carries its evidence -- P08 and P09 had both shipped to production with no TASK_REPORT.md and nothing noticed. release_mode PRODUCTION; live ac7cf4800e18 -> 39b87041c284.

test_results.command: P09 acceptance (runs the SHIPPED coverageGrid/coverageHTML against a REAL node:sqlite DB loading the REAL schema_cloud.sql)
test_results.observed: exit 0. The shipped SQL executes against the real schema; the output never claims a source did not exist; the grid covers ALL registered sources (a fixture with 6 registered vs 4 with items proves zero-item sources stay visible: stats-gov renders 0/127, not absent); covered+not_backfilled=cells; coverage_pct is computed not hardcoded; month window spans 2016-01..now across year boundaries; one batched pair of queries; empty DB does not divide by zero.

test_results.result: PASS (7/7 load-bearing, all decided by assertion, all reach the verdict)
test_results.observed: nc1 reintroduce source_not_yet_active; nc2 miscount not_backfilled; nc3 hardcode coverage_pct=100; nc4 drop the try/catch; nc5 move the window to 2026-01 (the 2016+ debt vanishes); nc6 revert to deriving the source list from cn_items (the reviewer's BLOCK-1 -- reds with '实得 4' vs 6); nc7 point the registry query at a non-existent table (the reviewer's BLOCK-3 -- a dumb mock could not catch this).

5 tests. Load-bearing: removing P08's TASK_REPORT.md -> FAIL naming it; setting a PRODUCTION bundle's live_build_after to 'TBD' -> FAIL. Written because the audit found P08 AND P09 had shipped to production with no TASK_REPORT.md at all; both backfilled. Deliberately scoped to what is universally true (cost sheet parses + declares release_mode, test-results non-empty, PRODUCTION names a 12-hex build) -- NOT nc_results/known_gaps, which only P07-P09 carry; a guard red on arrival just gets deleted.

aggregate rows_read=1694 (~2x table size 847; full scan + USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY; 69 result rows) + registry rows_read=74 = ~1768 rows per /system view -> ~2800 views/day against D1's 5M/day. CPU 0.51 of 10ms. External subrequests +0. Recorded honestly that this is a full scan growing linearly with cn_items and will need materialising if the 2016+ backfill lands.

build.json 39b87041c284; / /review /radar /library /watchlist /system all 200. /system renders: 登记在册 37 个来源 × 127 个月 = 4699 格 / 有条目 69 / 未回填 4630 / 时间覆盖率 1.5% / 从未抓到过任何条目的源：6 个（cell、cell-neuron、lancet、science-advances、stats-gov、gnews-us-tech）.

stop_conditions: 若将来真做 2016+ 回填把 cn_items 撑大，/system 的覆盖查询是全表扫、成本会线性增长 —— 必须先改成物化/缓存再放量。
绝不要为了让 coverage 数字好看而重新引入 source_not_yet_active 或任何「没有独立证据的解释」。

rollback.production: npx wrangler@4 versions deploy <previous-version-id> 回到 ac7cf4800e18。
rollback.repo: git revert 本 commit；只读视图，cn_items 未被改写，回滚无数据损失。

unresolved_risks: not_backfilled 作为兜底确实恒真（至今没跑过任何回填），故 unexplained 天然为 0 —— 正因如此才不拿它当「全面」的证据，页面呈现的是债务比例。
一个源若只有窗口外的条目会显示 0/127，不额外说明「其条目在窗口外」（复核提的次要项，未修）。
published_at 与 fetched_at 同时为 NULL 时该条目静默不计入（线上实测 both_null=0）。
6 个从未抓到条目的源（含 A0 官方源 stats-gov）是【真实的运维问题】，本批只负责让它可见，不负责修它。
